patterns={
 'AWS_KEY': re.compile(r'AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}'),
 'AWS_SECRET_ASSIGN': re.compile(r'AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY[^\n]{0,120}'),
 'GH_TOKEN': re.compile(r'ghp_[A-Za-z0-9]+'),

 'GITHUB_URL': re.compile(r'https://[redacted]@]+@github\.com'),
 'HF_LOGIN': re.compile(r'huggingface-cli login --token [redacted]
}
for path in root.rglob('*'):
    if '.git/' in str(path): continue
    if not path.is_file(): continue
    try:
        data=path.read_bytes()
        if b'\x00' in data[:4096]: continue
        text=data.decode('utf-8', errors='strict')
    except: continue
    hits=[]
    for name,pat in patterns.items():
        ms=list(pat.finditer(text))
        if ms:
            hits.append(f"{name}x{len(ms)}")
    if hits:
        print(str(path)+': '+','.join(hits))

root=pathlib.Path('.')
checks={
 'AKIA_pattern': re.compile(r'AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}'),
 'known_AWS_secret': re.compile(r'REDACTED00000000000000000021'),
 'known_HF_token': re.compile(r'REDACTED00000000000000000028'),
 'github_ghp': re.compile(r'ghp_[A-Za-z0-9]+'),
 'github_pat': re.compile(r'github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]+'),
 'hf_long_token': re.compile(r'hf_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}'),
 'generic_github_url_with_token': re.compile(r'https://[redacted]@/<]+@github\.com'),
}
# placeholders should exist
placeholders=['<your-aws-access-key-id>','<your-aws-secret-access-key>','<your-github-token>','<your-huggingface-token>']
print('=== secret checks (expect 0) ===')
any_secret=False
for name,pat in checks.items():
    total=0
    files=[]
    for path in root.rglob('*'):
        if '.git/' in str(path): continue
        if not path.is_file(): continue
        if path.suffix=='.tiktoken': continue
        try:
            t=path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
        except: continue
        c=len(pat.findall(t))
        if c:
            total+=c; files.append(f"{path}:{c}")
    # Special-case: generic_github_url_with_token will match our placeholder URL too; filter placeholder
    if name=='generic_github_url_with_token':
        # recount excluding placeholder
        total2=0; files2=[]
        for f in files:
            fp=f.split(':')[0]
            t=pathlib.Path(fp).read_text()
            for m in pat.finditer(t):
                if '<your-github-token>' not in m.group(0):
                    total2+=1
        print(f"{name}: {total2} (raw matches {total}; placeholder URLs excluded)")
        if total2: any_secret=True
        continue
    print(f"{name}: {total} {files if total else ''}")
    if total: any_secret=True
print('=== placeholder checks ===')
for ph in placeholders:
    total=0; files=[]
    for path in root.rglob('*'):
        if '.git/' in str(path): continue
        if not path.is_file(): continue
        if path.suffix=='.tiktoken': continue
        try: t=path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
        except: continue
        c=t.count(ph)
        if c: total+=c; files.append(f"{path}:{c}")
    print(f"{ph}: {total} {files}")
